input_email: Hi, I am Daniel from Acme Corp. Why is invoice INV-100 for $500? We have overages waived on our Pro plan.

steps.content:
Dear Daniel,

I am investigating your concerns regarding invoice INV-100 for $500. According to our records, the invoice consists of a $300 platform fee and a $200 overage charge. However, I have also reviewed your contract details, which indicate that you are on the Pro plan with overages waived.

Given this information, it appears that the $200 overage charge on your invoice is incorrect, as your plan waives overages. The $300 platform fee, however, is consistent with your monthly platform fee as per your contract.

I confirm that there is a billing error, and I will ensure that it is corrected. You should only be charged the $300 platform fee. I apologize for any confusion this may have caused and appreciate your patience as we rectify this situation.

Please let me know if you have any further questions or concerns.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
